story.logline: A technician discovers a calibration error, verifies the instrument, and chooses to document it.
story.story_promise: A private technical doubt becomes a shared record.
story.objective: Verify the error and place it on the supervisor's record.
story.initial_condition: The technician is alone with an instrument that should read forty.
story.final_outcome: The notched calibration card is clipped beneath the supervisor's signed sheet.

world_bible.instrument: gray analog pressure gauge with amber warning diode
world_bible.authored_object: blue calibration card with one asymmetric pencil notch

reference_registry.role: technician identity, uniform, and calibration bench

scenes.narrative_function: Move a private calibration doubt into a documented handoff.
scenes.audio_plan: Bench hum, switch clicks, and paper contact only; no score.

beats.description: Technician recognizes that the reading is wrong.
Instrument cycle proves the diode pattern and fixed needle position.
Technician places the notched card beneath the supervisor's sheet.

clips.narrative_job: Recognize the calibration error without announcing it.
clips.felt_intent: The viewer notices a practiced hand repeat one measurement it normally trusts.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Turn routine measurement into private recognition of an error.
authoring_state.turn: A trusted reading is routine, then its repeated mismatch becomes undeniable to the technician.
authoring_state.pov: The technician through the measuring hand; the gauge becomes suspect only after the pencil returns to the same notch.
authoring_state.power_shift: Routine procedure controls the opening; the repeated mismatch controls the technician's next action.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Verify the error without making a claim that could still be dismissed as operator mistake.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: The first mismatch could be hand error; reset the pencil at the asymmetric notch and repeat the measurement without looking toward the supervisor's empty chair.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: The technician performs an ordinary repeat while the exact placement admits the first reading mattered.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: The thumb starts to cover the notched number, then moves aside so the mismatch remains visible.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: A blue calibration card has one asymmetric pencil notch beside the forty mark.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No shocked face, alarm sting, or furtive glance; replace them with the pencil returning to the same asymmetric notch and the thumb moving away.
authoring_state.value_before: calibration doubt is private and deniable
authoring_state.value_after: calibration error is privately recognized but not disclosed
prompt_carriers: The pencil returns to the asymmetric notch beside forty for a second measurement.
The technician's thumb starts to cover the notched number, then moves aside.
The empty supervisor chair remains outside the technician's eyeline.

clips.transition_out: cut from visible notch to gauge face

clips.narrative_job: Show the instrument's verification cycle as a legible utility insert.
clips.felt_intent: The viewer can read two amber pulses while the needle remains fixed at forty.

authoring_state.utility_intent: Prove that the amber diode cycles exactly twice while the gauge needle remains fixed at forty.
authoring_state.non_narrative_refusal: No invented agency, menace, anxiety, or emotional reaction for the instrument.

planned_end_state.gauge_state: two amber pulses complete, needle still at forty

observed_end_state.gauge_state: two amber pulses complete, needle still at forty

clips.transition_out: cut from second pulse to calibration card
handoff_requirements: do not move the gauge needle
do not invent a performer reaction

clips.narrative_job: Document the verified error on the supervisor's record.
clips.felt_intent: The viewer sees responsibility change hands when the notched card enters the signed stack.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Turn private recognition into a documented decision another person must inherit.
authoring_state.turn: The calibration error is privately known, then the notched card makes it part of the supervisor's signed record.
authoring_state.pov: The technician through the card hand; the supervisor is represented by the signed top sheet rather than a reaction.
authoring_state.power_shift: The technician alone controls whether the error stays private; clipping the card beneath the signed sheet transfers responsibility to the record.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Make the error impossible to overlook without staging an accusation.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: A loose note could disappear; align the asymmetric notch beneath the supervisor's signature and close the metal clip through both sheets.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: The technician avoids confrontation by making the evidence physically inseparable from the supervisor's own page.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: The card pauses above the waste slot, then crosses to the signed stack without the hand changing speed.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: The asymmetric pencil notch remains visible directly beneath the supervisor's green signature.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No confession, accusatory look, or evidence close-up with music; replace them with the waste-slot pause and one metal clip closing through both sheets.
authoring_state.value_before: calibration error is privately recognized but not disclosed
authoring_state.value_after: calibration error is documented and responsibility becomes shared
prompt_carriers: The blue card pauses above the waste slot, then crosses to the supervisor's signed stack without the hand changing speed.
The asymmetric pencil notch aligns directly beneath the green signature.
One metal clip closes through the signed sheet and the notched card together.

clips.transition_in: intentional next shot from utility insert
